recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: creativity packed into a pencil case
September evening cooling over San Francisco
mostly clear sky after sunset at fourteen degrees
agents waiting to spin up from a phone pocket

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling pencil shavings before they scatter — each color fills a slot in a tiny pencil case. One compartment per round.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe to slide the open case left and right
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: fill exactly one pencil case compartment in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: shavings fall faster and autumn wind gusts shift their drift
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout stationery on a wooden desk

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold to keep an intellectual fly zipped shut against noise; release at the perfect beat to let one golden idea escape.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: hold and release on a single button
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: release at the narrow window to free exactly one thought
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: the fly buzzes louder and release windows shrink each cycle
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: surreal vintage anatomy diagram with muted ink

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick glowing orbs upward through an infinite scroll tunnel — break doomscroll gravity before the feed swallows you.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: flick upward to launch the orb
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one satisfying escape when the orb clears the tunnel lip
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: feed tiles regenerate faster and gravity strengthens mid-climb
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe abyss with scrolling tile fragments

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw fog paths across San Francisco hills connecting shortcut nodes — route agents from phone to repo before sunrise hits the bay.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to trace a continuous route between nodes
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: complete one sunrise delivery route before the timer ends
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog thickens, nodes multiply, and the sunrise deadline compresses
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor fog over bay bridges at dawn
